== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Well Guarded (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-wellguarded-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p3-15-Well_Guarded.png]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013); written-out icons (“(Immune to Alter)”, “(Virtual Block 4)”) are drawn as icons. Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. Non-unique aliens are immune to Grimtaash (While you have < 13 cards in hand) , The Camp, and deployment conditions on Watch Your Step. During battle with two non-unique aliens of your Rep's species, your aliens there may not have their forfeit reduced. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1281_15</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
